A documented bound states what the selection still cannot see and which tier covers it.
make pr-preflight uses the improved selection; CI parity tests and make pr-preflight pass.
context: 2026-10-21: in PR CI this is superseded by coverage selection (#3200, #3224) plus the importer scan for uncovered code; remaining scope is local make pr-preflight, which still maps by name.
description: The PR test step maps changed source files to tests by file name (benchbox/base.py to test_base.py), so PR 3185 never ran tests/test_benchbox.py, which mocks translate_query internals. The failing test only ran in the post-merge Trunk medium tier. A mapping by name misses tests that import or patch the changed module under another name.
